name: Methodios
notes: SABBATAI ZEVI SPLIT IN TWO: the Hierophant carries the claimant's volatility (real cycles of exaltation and collapse, not villain theatrics); Methodios is the Nathan of Gaza figure -- did not originate the claim, proselytized it across Act 2 (his preaching is the actual mechanism that produces sect consolidation; he is embedded in sect_march, RESOLVING the 'which sect' question on the Hierophant ending (RESOLVED 2026-09-23, see the_hierophant tab)). NOT RECRUITABLE by design -- his function depends on staying devoted after the party wins. Survives the capture/trial regardless of verdict and is the one who decides, theologically, what defeat means: reframes mercy as a hidden necessary descent (subterfuge route) or reframes execution as betrayal with no ambiguity left to manage (attrition-war route). Named for Cyril and Methodios, missionaries who invented a script specifically to translate scripture for people who'd never had access to it -- his function is the same one degree removed: translating a person's volatility into a doctrine other people can hold
